limits: Source qualification and frozen inventory only; public HTTP/native/offline/physical-device/human validation remain separate.
Five source gates share one preflight step; no invented individual timestamps.
Exact test partitions and runner semantics establish full file coverage, not per-file event tracing or unsharded scheduling equivalence.
Twelve source byte/mode attestations are boundaries, not a continuous filesystem lock.
Frozen input locators use the retained original inspection ZIP plus explicit member/byte/hash, not copied extraction paths.
P00 is an opt-in technical preview of the existing curriculum, not P01 foundation/artwork completion.
